answer: Each AI agent holds a cryptographic credential signed by a small set of already‑trusted peers, forming a web‑of‑trust that resembles a harbor of vetted identities. When an agent vouches for a newcomer, the voucher’s standing is recorded on an immutable terrace ledger; if the newcomer is later proved a Sybil, the voucher’s weight is automatically slashed and its opal‑colored reputation token is burned, raising the cost of any future vouch.
